<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="21" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">9:41</text>
    <line x1="319" y1="18" x2="319" y2="12" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="324" y1="18" x2="324" y2="10" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="329" y1="18" x2="329" y2="8" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="334" y1="18" x2="334" y2="6" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="350" cy="13" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="345" y1="18" x2="355" y2="18" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="365" y="8" width="20" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="367" y="10" width="15" height="7" rx="1" fill="#00C6AE"/>
    <rect x="386" y="11" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#18191F"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Minimal decorative composition -->
  <g opacity="0.9">
    <circle cx="70" cy="170" r="7" fill="#FFBD12"/>
    <circle cx="322" cy="245" r="8" fill="#FF89BB"/>
    <rect x="47" y="310" width="12" height="12" rx="3" fill="#00C6AE"/>
    <rect x="331" y="430" width="13" height="13" rx="3" fill="#1947E5"/>
    <circle cx="74" cy="570" r="6" fill="#F95A2C"/>
    <circle cx="318" cy="612" r="6" fill="#00C6AE"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Open Peeps standing blazer illustration -->
  <g stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round">
    <!-- hair silhouette -->
    <polygon points="142,169 146,133 165,105 196,94 225,100 247,122 252,157 239,181 151,183" fill="#18191F"/>
    <!-- face -->
    <circle cx="196" cy="164" r="49" fill="#FFC7DE"/>
    <!-- ear -->
    <circle cx="243" cy="168" r="10" fill="#FFC7DE"/>
    <!-- hair fringe -->
    <polygon points="145,151 151,119 174,101 202,96 225,105 234,126 209,121 194,137 173,127 165,155" fill="#18191F"/>
    <!-- face details -->
    <circle cx="179" cy="161" r="3" fill="#18191F" stroke="none"/>
    <circle cx="214" cy="161" r="3" fill="#18191F" stroke="none"/>
    <line x1="184" y1="185" x2="207" y2="185" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- neck -->
    <rect x="181" y="208" width="30" height="34" rx="7" fill="#FFC7DE"/>
    <!-- rear blazer shadow -->
    <polygon points="150,238 181,220 211,229 241,239 264,338 242,489 151,489 126,338" fill="#1947E5"/>
    <!-- left arm -->
    <polygon points="151,243 126,260 108,368 126,374 157,291" fill="#1947E5"/>
    <!-- left hand -->
    <circle cx="117" cy="374" r="13" fill="#FFC7DE"/>
    <!-- right arm -->
    <polygon points="237,242 263,258 282,365 264,371 232,294" fill="#1947E5"/>
    <!-- right hand -->
    <circle cx="273" cy="371" r="13" fill="#FFC7DE"/>
    <!-- white shirt -->
    <polygon points="181,229 196,250 211,229 224,273 196,305 168,273" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <!-- left blazer lapel -->
    <polygon points="181,229 196,250 181,293 164,267" fill="#8094FF"/>
    <!-- right blazer lapel -->
    <polygon points="211,229 196,250 211,293 228,267" fill="#8094FF"/>
    <!-- buttons -->
    <circle cx="196" cy="319" r="4" fill="#FFBD12"/>
    <circle cx="196" cy="342" r="4" fill="#FFBD12"/>
    <circle cx="196" cy="365" r="4" fill="#FFBD12"/>
    <!-- blazer lower edge -->
    <line x1="151" y1="489" x2="242" y2="489" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="3"/>
    <!-- trousers -->
    <polygon points="151,489 196,489 192,635 153,635" fill="#474A57"/>
    <polygon points="196,489 242,489 240,635 200,635" fill="#474A57"/>
    <!-- trouser crease -->
    <line x1="180" y1="500" x2="175" y2="622" stroke="#9FA4B4" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="212" y1="500" x2="216" y2="622" stroke="#9FA4B4" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- shoes -->
    <polygon points="153,625 190,625 198,645 191,658 143,658 142,647" fill="#18191F"/>
    <polygon points="201,625 239,625 251,646 248,658 199,658 193,646" fill="#18191F"/>
    <!-- shoe highlights -->
    <line x1="151" y1="646" x2="184" y2="646" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="207" y1="646" x2="241" y2="646" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Grounding shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="196" cy="676" rx="104" ry="11" fill="#EEEFF4"/>
  <line x1="111" y1="676" x2="281" y2="676" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Bottom navigation shadow and bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="766" width="390" height="78" fill="#18191F" opacity="0.10"/>
  <rect x="0" y="764" width="390" height="80" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="765" x2="390" y2="765" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Home tab -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="31,793 43,783 55,793" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="35" y="792" width="16" height="14" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="43" y="828" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">Home</text>
  </g>
  <!-- Discover tab -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="124" cy="794" r="11" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="124" y1="787" x2="124" y2="801" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="117" y1="794" x2="131" y2="794" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="124" y="828" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">Explore</text>
  </g>
  <!-- Messages tab -->
  <g>
    <rect x="201" y="784" width="24" height="18" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="207,802 211,808 216,802" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="209" cy="793" r="1.5" fill="#18191F" stroke="none"/>
    <circle cx="217" cy="793" r="1.5" fill="#18191F" stroke="none"/>
    <text x="213" y="828" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">Inbox</text>
  </g>
  <!-- Profile tab -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="309" cy="789" r="7" fill="#FF89BB" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="309" cy="802" rx="12" ry="7" fill="#FF89BB" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="309" y="828" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
